description: Source code implementing a text box dialog in a terminal UI, including functions for scrolling, rendering, and user interaction within a curses-like environment.

methods.name: back_lines
methods.description: Moves the 'page' pointer backwards by 'n' lines in the text buffer.

methods.name: get_line
methods.description: Retrieves the current line from the buffer, handling line truncation and end-of-buffer conditions.

methods.name: print_line
methods.description: Displays a single line of text in the specified window at a given row, handling horizontal scrolling.

methods.name: print_page
methods.description: Displays a page of text within the window, line by line.

methods.name: print_position
methods.description: Displays the current scroll position as a percentage.

methods.name: refresh_text_box
methods.description: Refreshes the dialog and box windows with current text content and position indicators.

methods.name: dialog_textbox
methods.description: Main function to display a scrollable text box dialog, handle user input, and manage scrolling and resizing.
